overall_notes: The paper focuses on generation steering using Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) for controllable text generation. Evaluation uses a combination of automatic metrics (generation success, perplexity) and LLM judges (Claude 3.7 sonnet). Note that some extracted metadata confused automatic metrics with LLM evaluation criteria.
